name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood
summary: The beast of the walking forest: it watches over its Auros in stasis and wakes them, one breath at a time.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: Control at least 3 Auros Entities and the opponent has already lost at least 8 HP from their Rubyfront, only in your Preparation Phase

faceA.name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.name: Memory of the Wood
effect.text: The first time each of your turns an Entity you control is untapped by an effect, you gain 1 HP.

woodBreath.name: Breath of the Wood
woodBreath.text: untap an Auros Entity you control.

faceA.flavor: You do not find the wood. The wood decides to find you.

faceB.name: Folded Glade

effect.name: Memory of the Glade
effect.text: The first time each of your turns an Entity you control is untapped by an effect, draw a card.

woodBreath.name: Breath of the Wood
woodBreath.text: untap an Auros Entity you control.

faceB.flavor: Here space folds upon itself, and what sleeps awakens.
